Requirement: 1200 units from ONE supplier, delivery <=25 days.

Eligibility check:
- Alpha: quantity 1700 >= 1200 PASS; delivery 35 <= 25 FAIL => disqualified
- Bravo: quantity 1000 >= 1200 FAIL; delivery 24 <= 25 PASS => disqualified
- Cobalt: quantity 1200 >= 1200 PASS; delivery 24 <= 25 PASS => qualified

Total landed cost formula:
Total = (Goods_USD + Shipping_USD) * (1 + duty_rate)
Goods_USD = Units * UnitPrice_Foreign * FX_to_USD

Alpha - 1200 units hypothetical:
Goods_Alpha_USD = 1200 * 13.53 * 1.08 = 16236 * 1.08 = 17534.88
Total_Alpha = (17534.88 + 900.00) * (1 + 0.12) = 18434.88 * 1.12 = 20647.0656
Disqualified on deadline.

Bravo - 1200 units hypothetical:
Goods_Bravo_USD = 1200 * 1922.3 * 0.0067 = 2306760 * 0.0067 = 15455.292
Total_Bravo = (15455.292 + 1500.00) * (1 + 0.04) = 16955.292 * 1.04 = 17633.50368
Disqualified on quantity: max 1000 < 1200 required.

Cobalt - 1200 units:
Goods_Cobalt_USD = 1200 * 15.6 = 18720.00
Total_Cobalt = (18720.00 + 600.00) * (1 + 0.00) = 19320.00 * 1.00 = 19320
Qualified on quantity and deadline.

Only Cobalt meets both quantity and deadline, so lowest qualified cost is Cobalt 19320.
